_comment: F31. Re-run with toolchain/bin/bd-mutate against a detached scratch copy. The mutant removes bd-band's environment pop, restoring the service/operator install directory at pytest collection time. The named catcher launches a real nested bd-band, records the child's initial environment, initializes SQLite only inside a sacrificial temporary install root, and requires that root to remain byte-for-byte unchanged. The separate transform-control spec applies the exact same replacement under the explicit test-owned negative control and must ESCAPE.
subject: every child-test launcher pops an inherited BD_INSTALL_DIR before collection

mutants.label: M1 bd-band forwards the operator install directory into nested pytest
mutants.new: # mutant: retain the inherited install directory
